notes: Gurugram Line 2 Phase 2 (Sector 9-Cyber City): GMRL floated Rs 1,662 cr civil tender ~5 Oct 2026, World Bank funded, bids 9-18 Nov, 30-month completion. Swarajya: 14.2 km, 13 stations in order: Sector 7, Sector 4, Sector 5, Ashok Vihar, Sector 3, Bajghera Road, Palam Vihar Extension, Palam Vihar, Sector 23A, Sector 22, Udyog Vihar Phase-4, Udyog Vihar Phase-5, Cyber City. Business Standard says 15.3 km / 14 stations - CONFLICT. Double-decker at Bajghera (~800 m) and Old Delhi Road (~1.2 km). Source: https://swarajyamag.com/news-brief/142-km-gurugram-metro-phase-2-corridor-from-sector-9-to-dlf-cyber-hub-gets-rs-1662-crore-tender ; https://www.business-standard.com/india-news/gurugram-metro-phase-2-haryana-clears-rs-1662-crore-tender-126100100358_1.html
Gurugram Line 2 Phase 1 (MCC-Sector 9, 15.2 km, 14 stations) ~15% physical progress as of Oct 2026; full corridor quoted 28.5 km / 27 stations, sanction Rs 5,452 cr.

Rithala-Kundli-Nathupur: Haryana cabinet approved revised DPR 24 Mar 2026 - Haryana segment 2.726 km, 2 elevated stations Kundli and Nathupur, Rs 545.77 cr (Centre 97.30, state 448.48). https://swarajyamag.com/amp/story/news-brief/haryana-clears-rs-33000-crore-delhipanipatkarnal-rrts-corridor-and-kundli-metro-extension
Sector 56-Pachgaon: Oct 2026 coverage gives 35.25 km elevated, 28 stations, awaiting state final approval (Swarajya article conflates it with Ballabgarh-Palwal headline).
Ballabgarh-Palwal: final feasibility report approved by Haryana 6 Oct 2026; DPR goes to MoHUA; reviewed at 66th HMRTC board (chair CS Anurag Rastogi).

Bata Chowk-Vatika Chowk vs March 2026 plan: HMRTC now proposes 18 metro stations sharing the Gurugram-Faridabad-Noida Namo Bharat track (Iffco Chowk-Gwal Pahari in Gurugram; NIT-Sectors 88-89 in Faridabad). Unclear whether this supersedes the standalone Bata Chowk-Vatika Chowk metro - CONFLICT/possible supersession.

Sonipat city metro: none found; a Haryana assembly answer said no metro proposal for Sonipat beyond the Delhi Metro extension. Rohtak: no metro proposal; 2021/2023 parliamentary replies say Haryana sent none; only Bahadurgarh-Sampla feasibility (2018) and Asaudha extension exist. Karnal/Panipat: only Namo Bharat RRTS ('five stations in Karnal' are RRTS, excluded). Rewari: only as Gurugram-Bawal MRTS spur (2016, dormant). Hisar: nothing found. Faridabad internal lines: none beyond Ballabgarh-Palwal and Faridabad-Gurugram.
